This option assembles NSAG, which is not a word — the child built letters and stopped without hearing them. It keeps the right two pieces in order but writes the SNOW piece backwards, NS for SN.

The example takes the first two letters of each outer word, so SNOW and AGREE give SNAG. This option takes WORE — letters that are in the outer words, but not the two pieces the example takes. W and O are the fourth and third letters of SNOW, and R and E are the third and fourth letters of AGREE.
